### Selected Story
The story is about Voyager 2’s close-up study of Neptune in 1989: it was the first—and remains the only—spacecraft to study the planet up close. Readers should understand that this encounter has not been repeated by another spacecraft.

### Story Progression
- **Context:** Establish Neptune as the subject of a close-up spacecraft study.
- **Development:** In 1989, NASA’s Voyager 2 became the first spacecraft to study Neptune up close.
- **Endpoint:** Voyager 2 remains the only spacecraft to have done so, making its encounter one no other spacecraft has repeated.
